# Dependencies for running the vendored diffsynth on a current GPU.
#
# Deliberately NOT a reconstruction of the 2021 environment. PL 1.4/1.5, which
# the original configs target, pairs with torch ~1.8-1.11, and those wheels are
# compiled for older CUDA compute capabilities -- on a current card they fail
# with "no kernel image is available for execution on the device", which no
# amount of pip pinning fixes. Porting the ~30 lines of removed PL 1.x API
# forward (see configs/trainer/default.yaml) is the cheaper and safer direction.
#
# torch and torchaudio are intentionally unpinned: install whatever build
# matches the driver already working on this machine, then install the rest.
#
#   python -m venv ~/dsenv && source ~/dsenv/bin/activate
#   pip install torch torchaudio          # or reuse the dafxenv build
#   pip install -r requirements-modern.txt
#
# torchcrepe and torchopenl3 are imported only by the f0 and perceptual-loss
# paths (diffsynth/f0.py, diffsynth/perceptual/). The paper's three models use
# neither -- f0: false in configs/data, perc_model: null in configs/model -- so
# they are listed last and can be skipped if they fight the resolver.

pytorch-lightning>=2.0
hydra-core>=1.1,<1.4
omegaconf>=2.1
nnAudio>=0.3
librosa>=0.10
soundfile>=0.12
numpy
matplotlib
tqdm
tensorboard

# optional, unused by the paper's three training procedures
# torchcrepe
# torchopenl3
